title: On Carving the new handle from ash wood
subtitle: 艺术殿堂 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 艺术殿堂（文学艺术与体育·绘画、建筑等领域的代表作品和人物）
meta: 主题语境：艺术殿堂（文学艺术与体育·绘画、建筑等领域的代表作品和人物）　|　核心词汇：carve　|　正文 356 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 carve 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1961 the observer ① carved the new handle from ash wood at once, and every assistant in the observatory said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three nights on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the observer ② carves the new handle from ash wood in the rain without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ carve the new handle from ash wood at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ carved the new handle from ash wood before — a line in the log for November 1955 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Carving the new handle from ash wood at once, the observer said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the lens at the far dome, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ carve a short line into the beam in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Carve a short line into the beam at once and never mention it again.

By 1968 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the log, and a new assistant from the next observatory ⑧ carves a short line into the beam at once every night without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the dome, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ carved the new handle from ash wood again when nobody else would.

⑩ To carve the new handle from ash wood, my mother said in 1973, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the observatory remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the observatory forgets, somebody carves the new handle from ash wood in the rain again and somebody must carve the new handle from ash wood at once all over again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 carve 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1961 the observer carved the new handle from ash wood at once, and nobody in the observatory forgot it.
Even now the observer carves the new handle from ash wood in the rain whenever the observatory asks.
Carving the new handle from ash wood at once, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever carve a short line into the beam in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new assistant from the next observatory carves a short line into the beam at once every night, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother carved the new handle from ash wood again, and the observatory remembered that half.
